svg.text: storage-handle mockup (roadmap §1c): one ArrayBase, sparse is a storage behind a handle + accessor
// two generics: the element type is Acc::Elem
ArrayView<'a, Acc, L> = ArrayBase<ViewRepr<'a, Acc>, L>
ArrayViewMut<'a, Acc, L>= ArrayBase<ViewMutRepr<'a, Acc>, L>
offset_range() = Some((0, 5)) // must fit the storage
// slice: new shape + handle shift via Acc::offset
offset(h, by) = h + by // slicing bumps the pointer
fill(h) = None DENSE = true -> iteration is layout-driven
OwnedRepr(Vec<A>) handle -> the Vec's heap block
Handle = SparseHandle { buf: NonNull<SparseBuf<A>>, base: isize }
get(h, o) = binary-search(base+o) in entries, else &fill
get_mut(h, o) = same, inserting (base+o, fill) on a hole
offset(h, by) = { buf, base + by } // a buf pointer can't be bumped
stored(h) -> [(o - base, &v)], the array maps o -> index_of(o)
OwnedSparse(NonNull<SparseBuf<A>>) // raw ptr + Drop, NOT Box:
moving a Box retags Unique and kills the handle (Miri)
fn slice_axis(&self, ax, start, len) -> (Self, isize);
// index_axis -> Smaller etc. per §1a (not in mockup)
trait Strided: AxisOps (next level, not in mockup)
type Handle: Copy; // stable across moves of ArrayBase,
unsafe fn offset(h, by: isize) -> Handle;
unsafe fn get_mut(h, off) -> &mut Elem; // only via &mut ArrayRef
// impls: Dense<A>, Sparse<A> (a family = an accessor)
storage traits (ownership kinds, each naming its family)

// handle points at heap memory that never moves with ArrayBase
unsafe trait Data: RawData {} // safe to read through
